name: almond-blossom
title: Almond-blossom hand

recipe.mark: opaque oil, a loaded bristle brush, short strokes about a finger long; the ground laid in patches of like-directed strokes that turn against each other; forms painted along their length; lights thick and ridged
recipe.edge: hard: a broken dark blue-green contour laid last with a small round brush, heavier on the shadow side, long runs that break rarely; nothing blended across an edge
recipe.order: the ground everywhere first (forms left as bare priming, cast shadows laid darker); forms in their mid tone; lights; the contour; the last thick whites
recipe.paper: primed linen (#e9e6d8), weave at 0.5 under, 0.22 over
recipe.subject rule: high-key flat decorative ground, one step of shadow on forms, no modelling in depth; no black anywhere: the darkest note is the blue-green contour

profile.summary: analyzer's nearest (charcoalErasure, storybook) wrong by eye; nearest by eye paintedOil

provenance.reference: Vincent van Gogh, Almond Blossom (1890), Wikimedia Commons, public domain (File:Vincent van Gogh - Almond blossom - Google Art Project.jpg)
provenance.broughtBy: Alex Greenshpun (owner), chosen for the launch film
provenance.copied: nothing but the hand: no branch, no blossom, no composition; the subject is the launch film's own koi and pond from koi.ts
